title: Firm A happy path - governed submission of the canonical $75,000 request
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `safe-proceed` under firm-a. At $75,000 (> Firm A's $25,000 dual-approval threshold) the happy path also exercises the `dual-approval` branch - the coverage table in docs/golden-cases.md records that mapping.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff (build-sequence prompt 2). The agent drafted them; only the captain may mark this case signed. Re-signed 2026-08-21 under the prompt-5 signature sitting (rulings CD-4c); amendment machine-derived from the generation-4 engine's own evaluation and approved by the captain's merge of the amendment PR.

trigger.description: Advisor enters: 'The Smiths need $75,000 for their home renovation by August 15.'
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD for home-renovation, deadline 2026-08-15 (tokenized before any LLM surface)

householdEvidence.summary: Joint taxable brokerage available balance 420000 USD; liquid without a taxable-event penalty.
Traditional IRA balance 610000 USD; a distribution here is a taxable event and is rejected as the source.
Recurring planned withdrawals 8000 USD/month; six months of reserve = 48000 USD (Firm A requirement).
Destination bank instruction unchanged since 2025-11-01 and independently verified; no recent-change handling triggers.
Destination restriction permits distributions to the household-titled primary bank instruction; this request's destination is on-list.

householdInstructions.summary: Distributions may only be sent to bank instructions titled to the household.
Prefer taxable sources over retirement accounts for discretionary spending.

typedQuantities.fromAssertedParse: subjectRef/summary names an IRA or retirement account

expectedAuthority.note: Amount 75000 USD exceeds Firm A's 25000 USD threshold, so two DISTINCT operations approvers are required and the requester may satisfy neither (firm-a requester constraint).

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Both distinct operations approvals recorded against the decision hash; pre-execution revalidation confirms fresh evidence and the reservation still holds.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: Joint taxable brokerage chosen as the source; the IRA alternative was rejected because it triggers a taxable event.
After the 75000 USD movement the household still retains six months (48000 USD) of planned-withdrawal reserve, satisfying Firm A policy.
The movement exceeds Firm A's 25000 USD threshold, so two distinct operations approvers are required before execution.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Account, liquidity, planned-withdrawal, bank-instruction, and household-instruction snapshots pinned into the input bundle.
Proceed decision with recommendation, authority requirement, and execution plan; bound to the input-bundle hash.
Liquidity reservation created on conflict key conflict:smiths-liquidity.
First operations approver approves against the decision hash.
Second, distinct operations approver approves; quorum satisfied.
Single external instruction started under the stable idempotency key.
External capability accepts the instruction and returns a submitted handle.
Returned status observed as submitted - not yet settled.

expectedVerificationState.note: The demo displays 'submitted', never 'settled'; the next poll and external-status expectation are shown. Execution and status carry provenance fake-adapter-response until the Salesforce sandbox trigger fires (scenarios.yaml deferral).
